method.time: Daily positions: 12:00 UTC{local}. Each row is a sample at that instant; it does NOT show the exact time of a sign change or of a retrograde station — a different sign on two consecutive days means the change happened between those two instants, not when.
method.zodiacWestern: Zodiac: tropical (true equinox and ecliptic, apparent geocentric position). North and South Lunar Node: true (osculating) node; the South Node is exactly opposite the North Node.
method.zodiacVedic: Zodiac: sidereal (Nirayana), Lahiri ayanamsa — the ONLY ayanamsa of this table; no other ayanamsa option is offered. Rahu: mean lunar node (equinox of date); Ketu is exactly opposite Rahu.
method.retro: Retrograde (℞): the actual retrograde flag of the calculation service for that day; it is not derived by comparing two days' positions.
method.rounding: Degrees and minutes are rounded down (truncated); the stored value is the full ecliptic longitude at 0.0001° precision.
method.chironVerified: Chiron: not checked independently at run time; independently verified against NASA/JPL Horizons data in sample months between {from}–{to} (largest difference 0.22″).
method.lilith: Black Moon Lilith (⚠ unverified): mean lunar apogee. {note} Not included in the default view or the report; the raw value is kept in the record.
method.missing: {bodies}: the calculation service returned no positions for this month; not shown in the table.
method.checkPass: Independent check: {compared} values were compared at the same instants with the Yaşam Sistemi local NASA/JPL DE440 calculation; largest difference {max}″ (within tolerance), retrograde mismatches {retro}.
method.checkUnavailable: The independent check could not be performed for this table.
method.checkUnavailableReason: The independent check could not be performed for this table: {reason}
method.deltaT: Time uncertainty (ΔT): for this period the difference in the Earth's rotation is not measured but estimated ({secs}). Positions may therefore be uncertain by at most: {list}; the outer planets are practically unaffected. Table values follow the calculation service's model.

verify.lilith: Black Moon Lilith (mean lunar apogee) could not be verified against an independent reference; its definition depends on the calculation model.
verify.chiron: Chiron was independently verified only for the years {from}–{to}; there is no verification for this period.

check.methodWestern: Yaşam Sistemi local JPL DE440 engine, same 12:00 UTC instant; apparent geocentric longitude, true ecliptic and equinox; North Lunar Node = true (osculating) node. Tolerance 1.0″ + ΔT uncertainty margin.
check.methodVedic: Yaşam Sistemi local JPL DE440 engine, same 12:00 UTC instant; sidereal longitude = apparent tropical longitude − true Lahiri ayanamsa (ICRC 1956 definition + IAU 2006 precession + nutation); Rahu = mean node. Tolerance 1.5″ + ΔT uncertainty margin.
check.reasonNotDe440: The independent local engine is not DE440; the check cannot be performed.
check.reasonNoData: Independent local ephemeris data is not available on this server; the check could not be performed.
check.reasonInvalid: The independent local calculation returned no valid result for this date; the check could not be performed.
check.reasonError: The independent local calculation could not be performed for this date; the check could not be performed.
check.reasonIncomplete: Values to compare are missing; the check could not be performed.

errors.crossFailed: The calculated positions did not pass the independent check (difference outside tolerance); the table is not shown or stored.

errors.providerFailed: This month could not be retrieved from the calculation service; the table is not shown with incomplete data. Please try again shortly.
errors.providerInconsistent: The calculation service's response did not pass the consistency check; the table is not shown.
errors.notCached: This month's table has not been calculated yet. Calculate the table first.
errors.tableRate: Too many tables were requested in a short time. Please try again shortly.
errors.storeUnavailable: Ephemeris record storage is not active yet. The table can still be viewed; it cannot be saved.
errors.dbError: The record operation cannot be performed right now. Please try again shortly.

skyTools.title: Sky calculations by date range
skyTools.lead: No birth data required. The monthly ephemeris is retrieved from our calculation service with one calculation per month and independently checked against the Yaşam Sistemi local engine; moon phases, degree crossings and the detailed local table are calculated by the local engine.
